name: Camping 101: Mining
summary: You learn to make a Lodestone for a wilderness camp. A campfire is also needed before you can start your camp.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: You can now craft your own Lodestone. To try it out, head into the wilderness; most folk do not want camps set up in the center of town. You will also need a campfire before starting your camp. A cook can teach you how to make one.

faq.answer: You can now craft your own Lodestone.

faq.q: Where should I try the Lodestone?
faq.answer: Head into the wilderness to try it out, since most folk do not care for camps in the center of town.

faq.q: What do I need before starting a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before starting your camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: A cook can teach you to make a campfire.
